name: busqueda-tesoro-tutorias
description: Treasure hunt web app — UTN FRRe Tutorías, Student Day

scripts.dev: concurrently -n web,api -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev:web" "npm run dev:api"
scripts.dev:lan: concurrently -n web,api -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev:web:lan" "npm run dev:api"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w packages/shared && npm run typecheck -w apps/web && npm run typecheck -w apps/api
scripts.test: npm run test -w packages/shared && npm run test -w apps/web && npm run test -w apps/api
